name: v2.26.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Bump docker/build-push-action from 7.3.0 to 7.4.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2265
* Clarify the test_db license by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2266
* Add PyPi badge to README.md by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2267
* Thoroughly revise CONTRIBUTING.md by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2268
* Remove support for Python 3.10 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2269
* Use "v" on version numbers in changelog.md by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2270
* Don't wait for Boundary tunnel teardown on quit by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2271
* Add keybindings to insert Unix timestamp literals by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2272
* Unset `PYTHONPATH` in `AGENTS.md` command suggestions by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2273
* Major dependency upgrade to PyMySQL v1.2.3 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2274
* Ability to complete partial enum values by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2275
* Prepare changelog for release v2.26.0 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2276


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/compare/v2.25.3...v2.26.0
